name: Bob Navigation Hotkeys
description: Ctrl+Shift+P always opens the Task Card, a focused first screen with exact P-level previews. Ctrl+Shift+B is Ctrl+Shift+P then `b`: it opens the Task Card's Depends on stage for the task, a Task Link's linked task, or a counted `N<Ctrl+Shift+B>` batch; Esc, q, or Ctrl+[ close it without writing, and its More section opens a property's value stage. Ctrl+Shift+Alt+B is Ctrl+Shift+P then `⇧B`: it opens the Blocks stage for a task or Task Link, supports counted `N<Ctrl+Shift+Alt+B>`, and works from Depends-On and BLOCKS lines, where Ctrl+Shift+P on a BLOCKS line also opens the owner’s stage directly. On an inbox task every non-closing answer asks where it goes before writing and moves there. Open and manage related notes, tabs, and task properties, including priority levels that roll scheduled dates. Ctrl+Enter on the card takes the recommended roll, decay, or cancel from the previewed ladder, including counted and Task Link batches. Scheduling a date opens one combined Reason and Work summary review; a Pending or Next task can record an optional Work Log summary as a dated entry under a WORK LOG child. A Cancel action closes tasks as Cancelled with an optional reason kept in a first-child Cancel Log. Alt+F and Ctrl+Alt+F ask for an optional Work Log summary before refreshing Pending tasks. On a landed RECURRING row both write nothing, show the recurring-tier notice, and stay. Ctrl+Enter on the PRE/POST row the review walk just landed on completes it and advances within the group when another live row remains (nav api v3). `]s` / `[s` away from the current review task first return to it. The Task Card level strip and priority notices render the shared signal-bar priority mark through the bob-ledger-tools api.priorityMarks v1 namespace, falling back to the Lucide signal icons without it. Alt+[ / Alt+] on a Pomodoro Task Link toggles the linked task between Next and In Progress — asking once for an optional Work Log summary when moving back to Next — through the nav api.taskLinkLane v1 namespace. Closing a planned task opens one grouped successor picker when offers exist; nothing starts selected, and the cycler applies only chosen links. The pulled-in summary is shown through nav api.notice v1. Review-row closes append the cycler's additive `successorNotice` line to the walk toast. Journals each counted ]s answer, with its outcome, through the bob-ledger-tools api.stats namespace. Depends-On writes now mirror open dependents into generated 🧱 BLOCKS lines, in the same-note transaction or a checked cross-note follow-up, including counted, marked, Ctrl+D, hand-edit (and undo), conversion, and Ctrl+Shift+M paths. Adding an open prerequisite from Ctrl+Shift+P also removes the newly Blocked task's live links from today's open Pomodoros, deleting an emptied entry. Cmd+Enter on a reading task, Task Link, or managed embed opens its source_pdf in Highlights without vault writes, while other targets retain Obsidian’s new-tab behavior. Turns on Templater's device-local "Trigger on file creation" when it is unset, so Cmd+N and other new notes get the vault's folder template (_templates/new_note.md). Only the BLOCKS chips in bob-ledger-tools use nav `api.blocks` v1, for ＋ and hover ×.
